authorship: House, barn, shed, well, bridge, crop growth meshes and animated water geometry are original game geometry using the registered CC0 scan materials. Carrot, tomato, corn, strawberry, potato, chili and orange do not have imported full photogrammetry models; their shapes remain authored for this game. Player-uploaded profile images, brand/UI graphics and the 2D compatibility renderer are not stock 3D assets.
